changed_files_note: queue_bridge.py: Codex (row fields). start_stage1_laptop.sh: Claude Code (calls the revision-aware verify_freeze.py and starts the Ollama version guard). Codex also edited FREEZE.json in place in commit 236f372; that edit was reverted and replaced by this file so that the original record stays unchanged.
ollama_auto_update: NOT DISABLED: Ollama for Windows has no documented switch; its updater (updater.go, hourly check) downloads to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Ollama\updates_v2 and installs silently. A Windows ACL deny on that folder was refused by the permission system and not applied. Detection only: version_guard.py. An update during the run restarts the server and fails the episode in flight.
ollama_version_note: recorded at the revision; the laptop's Ollama (Windows) updated itself from 0.40.16 to 0.40.17 on 2026-11-21 17:27 (dev studies and the lab: 0.40.16). verify_freeze.py and version_guard.py stop the run on any change.
reason: Row-plumbing defect found by the first start of the laptop queue (2026-11-21 17:52): the custodian bridge row had no `model` and `seed`, so queue_core.compact() raised KeyError after the first episode. Revision 1 copies model and seed from the attempt's queue cell into the bridge row (queue_bridge.py), adds a regression test through the real compact serializer, and rebuilds the missing compact rows in custody (Codex, REVISION_1_20261121.md; two completed cells kept, never re-run). Scoring, prompts, tasks, arms, specs and success criteria are unchanged: every other file hash of FREEZE.json verifies.
